data.title: Aker BioMarine Advances Merger as Aker Consolidates Majority Stake
data.description:
An update from Aker BioMarine ASA ( (DE:1PG) ) is now available.

Aker BioMarine ASA is advancing a previously announced merger with Aker Capital NewCo AS, an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Aker ASA, following shareholder approval in August 2026. The transaction is part of a broader restructuring under the Aker group, aimed at consolidating ownership and streamlining the corporate structure around Aker BioMarine.

As a key preparatory step, Aker Capital AS has transferred its 69,065,940 shares in Aker BioMarine, representing about 78.73% of the company’s shares and votes, to MergerCo, with Norwegian regulators granting an exemption from mandatory offer rules for the move. Aker Capital also remains party to a forward contract covering an additional 10,707,629 shares, or roughly 12.21% of voting rights, underscoring Aker’s continued control and potentially reinforcing stability and strategic alignment for existing stakeholders ahead of merger completion.

data.title: Kudelski’s NAGRAVISION and Plume Partner to Secure 30 Million Connected Homes
data.description:
Kudelski SA ( (CH:KUD) ) just unveiled an announcement.

NAGRAVISION, the media and entertainment technology arm of Swiss-listed Kudelski Group, has partnered with U.S.-based Plume to bolster cybersecurity in the connected home, integrating NAGRA Scout Threat Intelligence into Plume’s AI-powered subscriber experience platform for ISPs. The collaboration combines NAGRAVISION’s expertise in protecting hundreds of millions of devices with Plume’s global managed WiFi footprint, aiming to elevate digital trust and expand advanced security offerings for consumers.

The enhanced security solution is already deployed to more than 30 million subscribers, providing always-on, network-level protection against phishing, malware, and other cyberattacks across increasingly device-dense home networks. By enabling features such as scam and botnet detection, anomaly monitoring, and parental controls, the partnership helps ISPs differentiate beyond basic connectivity and opens new revenue opportunities in cybersecurity services, while positioning Kudelski’s NAGRA Scout suite as a foundational technology for future consumer and small-business protection solutions.

Serving more than 450 ISPs and about 50 million homes globally, Plume manages roughly 600 million connected devices through its OpenSync-enabled infrastructure, enhancing in-home connectivity and digital security across diverse networks.

data.title: Diriteks Dirilis Tekstil Suspends Dividends Amid Deep Losses
data.description:
Diriteks Dirilis Tekstil Sanayi ve Ticaret AS ( (TR:DIRIT) ) has issued an announcement.

Diriteks Dirilis Tekstil Sanayi ve Ticaret AS has reported a significant net loss for the 2025 financial period, compounded by substantial losses from previous years and required legal reserves, resulting in a net distributable profit of zero under both Capital Markets Board and legal accounting standards. As a consequence, the board has decided that no cash or stock dividends will be distributed to shareholders for the 2024 and 2025 financial years, signaling ongoing financial strain and limited returns for investors in the near term.

The company’s dividend table confirms that no payments will be made to ordinary shareholders, holders of privileged shares, employees, directors, or other stakeholders, with all dividend-related items recorded as zero for the period. This decision underscores the priority of balance-sheet repair and statutory compliance over capital distribution, and may affect investor sentiment by highlighting the depth of the firm’s operational and profitability challenges during the assessed years.

data.title: Advanced Systems Automation Shareholders Approve AGM Resolutions and Board Changes
data.description:

Advanced Systems Automation Limited reported the results of its annual general meeting held on 11 September 2026 in Singapore, where shareholders voted by poll on key ordinary and special business resolutions. The company’s audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 were adopted, directors’ fees of S$176,000 for the same period were approved, and authority to allot and issue shares under Singapore’s Companies Act and the Catalist Rules was granted.

Shareholders also approved the re-election of Chief Operating Officer and Executive Director Ms Gan Shiying, Sonia, who continues to be classified as a non-independent director under Catalist rules, reinforcing continuity in the company’s operational leadership. Resolution 3, concerning director Mr Lim Chen Chong, was withdrawn following his decision not to seek re-election for medical reasons, resulting in his retirement from the board at the conclusion of the AGM, a move that slightly reshapes the firm’s governance structure but leaves the core executive team in place.
